title: 第九章楚玉璃 王麻子我一定要杀了你第十章解决王麻子李长寿太苟了
slug: 多子多福照顾女帝一天修为涨一万
lines: “你的夫君是谁？”
“我的家就在那边，他叫王麻子。”
李长寿一趴大腿，果然和他猜的一样。
不珍惜自家女人，惦记别人家妻子的恐怕也只有王麻子了。
李长寿看着眼前哭得梨花带雨的女子，用真实之眼扫了一眼。
【姓名：楚玉璃】
【年龄：十八岁】
【灵根：下品灵根】
【境界：无】
【身份：黑风城城西王麻子妻子，（因王麻子觉得家花没有野花香，没有韵味，并无夫妻生活）】
【目标：第一意愿：击杀王麻子，好好生存下去，第二意愿：顺从王麻子渴望得到他的青睐，好好活下去。第三意愿：自刎归天，离开这残忍没有爱的世界。】
看着这系统面板，李长寿大概知道了是怎么回事。
‘难怪会深夜拜访，兴许是王麻子出去浪荡，楚玉璃不甘天天受辱，这才鼓起勇气来到这里。’
‘估计这次要是失败，将会触发她的第三意愿。’
李长寿撸了撸胡须，微微颔首。
他也不忍这样惊艳的女子死去，更何况还是有灵根的。
没有功法无法吸收天地灵气，想必她也并不知道自己是有灵根的。
“还请大叔帮帮我，助我成为真正的女人。”
“我想要好好活下去。”
噗！
楚玉璃噗的一声跪倒在地，对着李长寿乞求道。
‘这女人倒还是个完璧之身，85的评分倒也不算低。’
‘老夫的系统本就是多子多福，不娶妻多生子怎么变强？’
一番权衡下，李长寿竟忍不住心动了。
苏千凡毕竟是他的妻子，这件事得好好商量一下，不能妄下定论。
“我问你，如果老夫能够帮你灭杀王麻子，你可愿意做我的女人？”
“击杀王麻子。”跪在地上的楚玉璃心弦紧绷，就连带满泪珠的神情都僵住了。
杀死王麻子是她的第一意愿，感觉问题不大。
只需要给她足够的时间思考，或许就能够成功。
content_en:
"Who is your husband?"
"My home is over there, his name is Wang Mazi."
Li Changshou leaned on his lap, and it was exactly as he guessed.
Wang Mazi is probably the only one who doesn't cherish his own women and cares about other people's wives.
Li Changshou looked at the crying woman in front of him and glanced at her with the eyes of truth.
[Name: Chu Yuli]
[Age: 18 years old]
[Spiritual roots: low-grade spiritual roots]
[Realm: None]
[Identity: Wife of Wang Mazi in the west of Black Wind City, (because Wang Mazi feels that the flowers at home do not have the fragrance of wild flowers, have no charm, and there is no married life)]
[Goal: The first wish: to kill Wang Mazi and live well. The second wish: obey Wang Mazi’s desire to gain his favor and live well. The third wish: commit suicide and leave this cruel and loveless world. 】
[Rating: 85]
[Favorability: 10]
Looking at the system panel, Li Changshou probably knew what was going on.
'No wonder he visited late at night. Maybe Wang Mazi went out to wander around, and Chu Yuli was unwilling to be humiliated every day, so she mustered up the courage to come here. ’
‘It is estimated that if she fails this time, her third will will be triggered. ’
Li Changshou stroked his beard and nodded slightly.
He couldn't bear the death of such a stunning woman, let alone one with spiritual roots.
Without skills, she cannot absorb the spiritual energy of heaven and earth. She must not know that she has spiritual roots.
"Please help me, uncle, to help me become a real woman."
"I want to live well."
Poof!
Chu Yuli fell to her knees with a pop and begged Li Changshou.
‘This woman is still in perfect condition, and her score of 85 is not a low one. ’
‘My system is to have more children and you will be blessed. How can you become stronger if you don’t marry a wife and have more children? ’
After some weighing, Li Changshou couldn't help but feel moved.
After all, Su Qianfan is his wife. This matter must be discussed carefully and cannot be made hastily.
"Let me ask you, if I can help you kill Wang Mazi, will you be my woman?"
"Kill Wang Mazi." Chu Yuli's heartstrings tightened as she knelt on the ground, and even her expression filled with tears froze.
Killing Wang Mazi was her first wish, so it didn't feel like a big problem.
As long as she is given enough time to think, she may be able to succeed.
title_en: Chapter 9 Chu Yuli Wang Mazi, I must kill you Chapter 10 Dealing with Wang Mazi Li Changshou is too stubborn
